preprocessing_description: ColumnTransformer: (1) Time + V1-V28 -> mean-impute -> StandardScaler; (2) Amount -> median-impute -> log1p -> StandardScaler. Fit only on training data.
training_description: Trained on SMOTE-resampled / cost-sensitively-weighted training data (model-dependent); threshold selected on a held-out validation set by minimizing business cost subject to a minimum recall of 0.75; reported once on an untouched test set.
limitations: Dataset is a fixed historical snapshot (September 2013, European cardholders).
V1-V28 are anonymized PCA-derived features with no disclosed real-world meaning.
Real-world fraud patterns drift over time; this model is not continuously retrained.
COST_FN / COST_FP and the resulting threshold are illustrative business assumptions, not verified figures from a real financial institution.
Not verified as production-ready for real banking systems without further validation, monitoring, and periodic retraining on live data.
